headline: French government doubles aid to drivers to head off fuel price crisis
description: With gasoline and diesel prices surging again, the French government will issue a new €100 payment to drivers who use their cars for work. Around 5.5 million people in France will be eligible. The aim: to nip any potential protest movement in the bud.

description: They hold key positions at the Holy See and are establishing think tanks, foundations and universities in Rome. headline: Inside the Hamidovic clan's reign of terror over young female pickpockets in the Paris métro
description: They name their children Dior or Al Capone and love designer clothes and luxury cars. To maintain their lavish lifestyle, the men of the Hamidovic clan – a Romani family of Bosnian origin – have maintained a reign of fear over an army of young female pickpockets on Paris public transportation. One branch of the network is on trial in Paris from September 15 to 23.
